name: FV_PAYMENT_EXCLUSION_CRITERIAS
description: This table contains payment offset exclusion criterias so that no  payment netting will be done by treasury for the payments meeting the criterias. Payment exclusion will be done at supplier, supplier site, supplier type, payment reason and by accounting range.

columns.name: EXCLUSION_CRITERIA_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the exclusion criteria.

columns.name: EXCLUSION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique code for exclusion type. The valid values are Supplier, Supplier Sites, Accounting, and Payment Reason. These values come from ORA_FV_OFFSET_CRITERIA_TYPE.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.description: Unique supplier identifier for which the payment is to be excluded in netting.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.description: Unique supplier site identifier to be excluded from the payment netting.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Supplier type codes to be excluded from the payment netting. Valid values will be provided by the lookup type VENDOR_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE.

columns.name: PAYMENT_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Payment reason for which the payment is excluded from the payment netting. Valid values comes from lookup type PAYMENT_REASON.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the business unit associated to the treasury offset criteria.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date when this criteria is applied.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date when this criteria is applied.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_RANGE_FILTER
columns.description: Accounting filter condition for which the payment is excluded from the payment netting.
